title: Sweet and Spicy Chicken Thighs
description: Boneless thighs bake in an orange and mild ancho glaze with extra heat available at the table.
equipment: Ninja Crispi, 4-qt glass container and adapter

steps.title: Simmer the sauce
steps.text: Whisk {broth}, {orange}, {honey}, {ancho}, {garlic}, {amino} into the HexClad. Simmer gently for 2 minutes until combined.

steps.title: Thicken
steps.text: Whisk {starch} with {cold}, then stir into the simmering sauce for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Prepare the dish
steps.text: Start with the room-temperature 4-qt glass container, no crisper plate. Let sauce cool to lukewarm before adding to the glass. Spread the sauce over the base.

steps.title: Prepare the chicken
steps.text: Unfold {chicken} into an even layer and trim any loose fat.

steps.title: Cook in sauce
steps.text: Nestle the pieces in the sauce in a single layer. Fit the 4-qt adapter and PowerPod and select Bake. Cook for 20–29 minutes, checking the thickest piece early. Finish at 175°F in the center.

steps.title: Serve generously
steps.text: Spoon hot sauce over each serving.

notes: Make ahead: prepare the sauce a day ahead and refrigerate separately. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Freeze cooked portions with sauce, cooled within 2 hours, for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: cover and warm gently with a spoonful of water to 165°F. Freezer reheat: thaw overnight in the fridge, then reheat covered to 165°F. Option A uses the listed seasonings. For gentler Option B, omit added citrus, vinegar or chile where used. Pass additional heat at the table. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 209 kcal, 25.6 g protein, 13.9 g total carbohydrate, 5.2 g fat, 0.3 g fiber, 211 mg sodium.

steps.text: Whisk {broth}, {orange}, {honey}, {ancho}, {garlic}, {amino} into the HexClad. Simmer gently for 2 minutes until combined.

steps.text: Whisk {starch} with {cold}, then stir into the simmering sauce for 1 minute until it coats a spoon.

steps.title: Prepare the dish
steps.text: Preheat the Samsung oven to 365°F on Bake. Choose a shallow baking dish. Spread the sauce over the base.

steps.title: Prepare the chicken
steps.text: Unfold {chicken} into an even layer and trim any loose fat.

steps.title: Cook in sauce
steps.text: Nestle the pieces in the sauce in a single layer. Place the baking dish on the middle rack. Cook for 23–32 minutes, checking the thickest piece early. Finish at 175°F in the center.

steps.title: Serve generously
steps.text: Spoon hot sauce over each serving.
